ev.q: In 2021, 1.6% of adults aged ≥18 years reported having ever had hepatitis.
The percentage of adults who ever had hepatitis was higher in men than women aged 45–64 years (2.7% versus 1.9%)
Percentage* of Adults Aged ≥18 Years Who Have Ever Had Hepatitis
Prevalence increased with age for both men and women.
The percentage of adults who ever had hepatitis was higher in men than women aged 45–64 years (2.7% versus 1.9%) and ≥65 years (3.2% versus 2.3%)
Estimates are based on household interviews of a sample of the civilian, noninstitutionalized U.S. population.
